candidates.review_note: All operations preserve monotonicity in the initial input X. Sort and deduplicate queried X values, then represent current results with a segment tree supporting affine updates Y := a*Y+b*X+c. Endpoint results give each node minimum and maximum. After every instruction, clamp entire out-of-range prefix/suffix subtrees to L/R and descend only across the two threshold boundaries. Lazy affine composition handles +, -, *, and @ uniformly; uniform-result nodes collapse to constant tags to avoid unnecessary coefficient growth. Finally restore original query order. The per-instruction clamp is never deferred past the next instruction.
